body:
Redline round 3

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 2 (2b737ed..4223a3e).

The round 2 fix changes the resume clause for the Finish comment. When the agent finds its comment already posted, it now sets `posted` to true and `comment_url` to "", and no longer asks for a URL. That matches what the code does: `redline-gh.sh pr-comments` is a plain `gh pr view --comments`, which prints no URL, and no code in the workflow reads `comment_url`, so the empty value is safe, while `handoffPosted` takes `posted` as the agent reports it. The loop test pins the new clause word for word and checks that `handoffPosted` stays true when `comment_url` is empty, and the `workflow/agents` and `testing/tests` standards describe the rule. This round found nothing new.

No findings.
